annotations.title: Forms your client fills in themselves

description: WHITE LABEL: a link your client opens, with no Hermoso login, to fill in details only they have, shown under your welcome screen: kind sms_sender_registration (legal name, business type, tax id, address, contact, use case, two sample messages, how people opt in: what carriers ask before delivering a business's texts) or caller_id_identity (the name shown when you call, logo, reason, numbers called from, website, contact). action create: kind, expiresInDays (1 to 30, default 14), note; returns the url. list: this brand's forms (allBrands:true for all). get: the answers once submitted (validated field by field before they are stored). revoke: stop the link. file: send the submitted answers to the brand's phone connection (the filing register_sms_brand / create_sms_registration_bundles / register_branded_calling make): a dry run without confirm, confirm:true files it after the user agrees (a carrier may charge a fee).
name: manage_hosted_forms
title: Forms your client fills in themselves
